summary.text: Jordan Redman is a Republican who represents District 3 (Seat B) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a second term; the directory lists Redman as a business owner.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography says Redman was born in Coeur d'Alene, is a lifelong North Idaho resident, and attended North Idaho College, Whitworth University and the University of Idaho.
It describes business interests in insurance and financial services, medical and real estate, and lists Redman as president of the Independent Insurance Agents & Brokers of Idaho.
